The '''TH-15A Medic''' was a type of [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|Mandalorian armor]] and a variation of the [[RD-15A Imperial Assault]] in usage during both the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and [[Galactic War]].
